guidebook.npc.quest.alto.0.desc_1: I ran into a researcher at the C-70 Laboratory in the Wasteland.
guidebook.npc.quest.alto.0.title: The Gateway Beyond &a[START]
guidebook.npc.quest.alto.1.desc_1: The researcher says he was part of the &bContinuumCorp&r team that worked on opening the portal.
guidebook.npc.quest.alto.1.desc_2: Despite the lack of thorough scouting, the corporation proceeded with colonization of the world on the other side — which would come back to haunt them a few years later when native life was discovered.
guidebook.npc.quest.alto.1.desc_3: These creatures proceeded to overrun the &bAbyss&r settlements, and forced the &cemergency closure of the portals&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.alto.1.desc_4: However, the act also caused a large percentage of the world's population to &cspontaneously mutate&r as well, perhaps due to them already being infected earlier.
guidebook.npc.quest.alto.1.desc_5: The researcher &bbroadcast the cure&r sent by his colleagues in the Abyss across the Internet despite it being incomplete, hoping others would have time to finish the work they started.
guidebook.npc.quest.alto.1.desc_6: He requires some materials to restore his &bresearch keycard&r, which should allow reactivation of the portal.
guidebook.npc.quest.alto.1.title: The Gateway Beyond &e[1]
guidebook.npc.quest.alto.2.desc_1: The researcher says the other keycard can be obtained from &bJackson&r in the &6military base&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.alto.2.desc_2: The military keycard is required to gain access to the portal room, at which point the research keycard can be used to reactivate it.
guidebook.npc.quest.alto.2.title: The Gateway Beyond &c[END]
guidebook.npc.quest.blake.0.desc_1: I ran into a technician in the Highrise Office District.
guidebook.npc.quest.blake.0.title: The Exhausted Technician &a[START]
guidebook.npc.quest.blake.1.desc_1: Blake seems exhausted from overwork — to the point where he can barely form sentences.
guidebook.npc.quest.blake.1.desc_2: He &cdoesn't seem to know anything about the cure&r, but needs your help to make the zombies outside quieter.
guidebook.npc.quest.blake.1.title: The Exhausted Technician &e[1]
guidebook.npc.quest.blake.2.desc_1: The technician says that while the source of the noise has lessened, another kind of special infected is now causing problems for him.
guidebook.npc.quest.blake.2.title: The Exhausted Technician &e[2]
guidebook.npc.quest.blake.3.desc_1: The technician's final request seems to be to get him some pillows so he can get some sleep.
guidebook.npc.quest.blake.3.title: The Exhausted Technician &e[3]
guidebook.npc.quest.blake.4.subtitle: Let him sleep in peace.
guidebook.npc.quest.blake.4.title: The Exhausted Technician &c[END]
guidebook.npc.quest.charlie.0.desc_1: I ran into the owner of the Gun Store in the Retail District.
guidebook.npc.quest.charlie.0.title: The Taste of Freedom &e[START]
guidebook.npc.quest.charlie.1.desc_1: The gunstore owner refuses to talk or trade until I kill some infected to prove I'm worthy.
guidebook.npc.quest.charlie.1.title: The Taste of Freedom &e[1]
guidebook.npc.quest.charlie.2.desc_1: The gun store owner wants me to kill some more infected.
guidebook.npc.quest.charlie.2.title: The Taste of Freedom &e[2]
guidebook.npc.quest.charlie.3.desc_1: Still not satisfied with what I've done, the store owner now wants me to kill a special infected called The Skeeper.
guidebook.npc.quest.charlie.3.desc_2: He says it looks like a thin zombie with a basket on its head.
guidebook.npc.quest.charlie.3.title: The Taste of Freedom &e[3]
guidebook.npc.quest.charlie.4.desc_1: The gun store owner wants me to kill one last infected, a &cLurker&r inside the &6Terraace Plaza Mall&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.charlie.4.title: The Taste of Freedom &e[4]
guidebook.npc.quest.charlie.5.desc_1: Now that I've completed his tasks, the gun store owner seems much more chatty.
guidebook.npc.quest.charlie.5.desc_2: He tells me that the research group working on the &bcure&r at the &6Terrace Plaza Mall&r has &cmost likely been wiped out&r, though there may still be &bthings left there to investigate&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.charlie.5.desc_3: He also says that he sells the &bgas mask&r and &bblueprint for it,&r a necessary item to be able to enter the &6wasteland&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.charlie.5.desc_4: The funds to purchase it can be gotten from someone at the &6Casino&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.charlie.5.title: The Taste of Freedom &c[END]
guidebook.npc.quest.chuck.0.desc_1: I ran into a chef in the Highrise Residential District.
guidebook.npc.quest.chuck.0.title: The Lumberjack Chef &a[START]
guidebook.npc.quest.chuck.1.desc_1: He seems to be content cooking good food and doing carpentery — even through the world has collapsed around him.
guidebook.npc.quest.chuck.1.desc_2: He wants me to kill some zombies in exchange for what he knows about the &bcure&r, and a good meal.
guidebook.npc.quest.chuck.1.title: The Lumberjack Chef &e[1]
guidebook.npc.quest.chuck.2.desc_1: Having cleared out the zombies, the chef now wants me to collect some saplings for his firewood stockpile. He doesn't seem to want to take no for an answer.
guidebook.npc.quest.chuck.2.title: The Lumberjack Chef &e[2]
guidebook.npc.quest.chuck.3.desc_1: Having gathered the firewood, Chuck gives me some information on the &bcure&r:
guidebook.npc.quest.chuck.3.desc_2: A group at the &eCasino&r in the &6Highrise Hotel District&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.chuck.3.desc_3: A group at the &eTerrace Plaza Mall&r in the &6Retail District&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.chuck.3.title: The Lumberjack Chef &c[END]
guidebook.npc.quest.emily.0.desc_1: I ran into a police officer staffing one of the police stations in the Suburb Residential District.
guidebook.npc.quest.emily.0.title: The Last Officer &a[START]
guidebook.npc.quest.emily.1.desc_1: She &cdoesn't seem to know anything about the cure&r besides that a shipment was supposed to arrive, but seems to be willing to ask around on her radio for more information.
guidebook.npc.quest.emily.1.desc_2: However, she seems to need my help clearing out some of the zombies threatening the local survivors.
guidebook.npc.quest.emily.1.title: The Last Officer &e[1]
guidebook.npc.quest.emily.2.desc_1: Emily reports that the area is safer now thanks to your efforts, but the survivors could use some supplies to get re-established.
guidebook.npc.quest.emily.2.title: The Last Officer &e[2]
guidebook.npc.quest.emily.3.desc_1: Emily says that there was a &bshipment of the cure&r sent to one of the &blocal hospitals or clinics&r, but she has no idea if it actually arrived.
guidebook.npc.quest.emily.3.desc_2: However, she has had some sucess in finding groups that may have been working on the cure:
guidebook.npc.quest.emily.3.desc_3: &7- A group in the &eCourtyard Office&r &7in the &6Highrise Office District&r
guidebook.npc.quest.emily.3.desc_4: &7- A group in the &eVertical School&r &7in the &6Highrise Residential District&r
guidebook.npc.quest.emily.3.desc_5: &7- And some strange signals coming from a &eHospital&r
guidebook.npc.quest.emily.3.subtitle: Anyone here?
guidebook.npc.quest.emily.3.title: The Last Officer &c[END]
guidebook.npc.quest.ford.0.desc_1: I ran into a mechanic in one of the workshops in the Highrise Office District.
guidebook.npc.quest.ford.0.title: The Long Drive &a[START]
guidebook.npc.quest.ford.1.desc_1: He seems to be assembling a car to be able to travel out of the city, but lacks the resources to do so.
guidebook.npc.quest.ford.1.title: The Long Drive &e[1]
guidebook.npc.quest.ford.2.desc_1: Unfortunately, Ford &cdoesn't seem to know anything about the cure&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.ford.2.desc_2: He seems to be convinced that if there was one, it means there would be other survivors, which increases his chances of survival.
guidebook.npc.quest.ford.2.desc_3: However, he's still missing some tools to finish his car.
guidebook.npc.quest.ford.2.title: The Long Drive &e[2]
guidebook.npc.quest.ford.3.desc_1: Ford seems shocked once he finds out that civilization has collapsed entirely, especially since the &bmilitary&r had announced they were &bquarantining the portals&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.ford.3.desc_2: Despite his attempts now being futile, he still wants to at least finish the car he's been working on.
guidebook.npc.quest.ford.3.title: The Long Drive &e[3]
guidebook.npc.quest.ford.4.desc_1: With the car now complete, Ford plans to leave eventually, but allows me to browse whatever he has in his workshop in the meantime.
guidebook.npc.quest.ford.4.subtitle: Guy's Last Tour
guidebook.npc.quest.ford.4.title: The Long Drive &c[END]
guidebook.npc.quest.gramps.0.desc_1: I ran into a grumpy veteran in one of the houses in the Suburb Residential District.
guidebook.npc.quest.gramps.0.title: The Old Veteran &a[START]
guidebook.npc.quest.gramps.1.desc_1: He doesn't seem to mind the infection around him — nor does he care for me in particular.
guidebook.npc.quest.gramps.1.desc_2: He believes the cure is a conspiracy to make people hold out hope.
guidebook.npc.quest.gramps.1.title: The Old Veteran &e[1]
guidebook.npc.quest.gramps.2.desc_1: The veteran is not amused about my heroics, but tells me about a special infected called the Wheezer.
guidebook.npc.quest.gramps.2.desc_2: It wears a straw hat, and breathes a pink mist. It can be found spawning in the Suburb Residential District.
guidebook.npc.quest.gramps.2.title: The Old Veteran &e[2]
guidebook.npc.quest.gramps.3.desc_1: The veteran tells me about a group of survivors trying to &brecreate the cure&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.gramps.3.desc_2: He says they can be found in the &blandmark buildings of each district&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.gramps.3.subtitle: Last one out, turn off the lights.
guidebook.npc.quest.gramps.3.title: The Old Veteran &c[END]
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.0.desc_1: The officer says that the military was dispatched to &cshut down the portals&r under the codename &bOperation Gatekeeper&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.0.desc_2: Even though civilization has collapsed, they continue to hold the quarantine, to prevent any more infected from escaping the district.
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.0.desc_3: Among these infected is the &cDemolisher&r, which can be found in the &6military base&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.0.title: guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.1^The Final Order &e[1]
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.2.desc_1: The officer explains that the shutting down of the portals was necessary in order to &cprevent the entities inside the abyss from escaping&r, which in his opinion are far more dangerous than what's here now.
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.2.desc_2: After that, they started evacuating the district.
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.2.desc_3: Before he can continue, the officer requires help in killing &cPatient Zero&r, which can be found in the &6Abandoned Hangar&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.2.title: The Final Order &e[2]
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.3.desc_1: The officer talks about the &cAbyss Sickness&r, a strange illness that initially only affected people working inside the abyss.
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.3.desc_2: Dismissed as a minor disease, its &ctrue nature was only revealed once the portals were closed&r, whereupon everyone who had caught it instantly transformed into the infected.
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.3.desc_3: The military, who were tasked to keep the abyssal creatures from escaping, were suddenly surrounded and trapped.
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.3.desc_4: Their main base of operations, the &6C-X Military Complex&r, was overrun and abandoned, and could use your help clearing it, specifically a boss monster called the &cFlayed Man&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.3.title: The Final Order &e[3]
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.4.desc_1: With the complex now clear, the officer can now turn his attention to securing the district.
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.4.desc_2: To do so, the &cClogger&r in the &6Nuclear Reactor&r must be killed.
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.4.desc_3: &cWARNING:&r The Nuclear Reactor is &ahighly irradiated&r and will require radiation protection. It is advised to familiarize yourself with the &6Radiation&r chapter in this guidebook before proceeding!
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.4.title: The Final Order &e[4]
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.5.desc_1: The officer informs you that there's a reseatch team in the &6C-07 Laboratory&r trapped by an infected called the &cHeavy&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.5.desc_2: In return, he will give me his &bkeycard&r, which is needed to access the portal room.
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.5.title: The Final Order &e[5]
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.6.desc_1: The military officer says the other keycard can be obtained from &bDr. Alto&r in the &6C-07 Laboratory&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.6.desc_2: The military keycard is required to gain access to the portal room, at which point the research keycard can be used to reactivate it.
guidebook.npc.quest.jackson.6.title: The Final Order &c[END]
guidebook.npc.quest.john.0.desc_1: I ran into the owner of the Casino in the Highrise Hotel District.
guidebook.npc.quest.john.0.title: The Fallen King &a[START]
guidebook.npc.quest.john.1.desc_1: The casino owner says there were a group of researchers working on the &bcure&r at the casino, but unfortunately they were overrun by the infected.
guidebook.npc.quest.john.1.desc_2: He offers to &btry and find where they left it&r if you help clear out some of the horde.
guidebook.npc.quest.john.1.title: The Fallen King &e[1]
guidebook.npc.quest.john.2.desc_1: The casino owner says the researchers left the &bpapers&r in his secret vault — however, he seems to have &cforgotten where it is located&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.john.2.desc_2: He says the location of the vault should be on some &bmusic discs&r in his &6penthouse&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.john.2.title: The Fallen King &e[2]
guidebook.npc.quest.john.3.desc_1: The casino owner says that the location of the vault is at the &bbottom layer of the Casino, using the fire exit stairs&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.john.3.title: The Fallen King &c[END]
guidebook.npc.quest.piko.0.desc_1: I ran into a shopkeeper at the Terrace Plaza Mall in the Retail District.
guidebook.npc.quest.piko.0.title: The Lone Shopkeeper &a[START]
guidebook.npc.quest.piko.1.desc_1: The shopkeeper seems to have been told by her father to guard the shop. After telling her that rescue will not be coming, she requests items to create a transmitter to let her father know.
guidebook.npc.quest.piko.1.title: The Lone Shopkeeper &e[1]
guidebook.npc.quest.piko.2.desc_1: The shopkeeper requires more parts to complete the transmitter.
guidebook.npc.quest.piko.2.desc_2: While she &cdoesn't know anything about the cure&r, she says her father who works for the military might.
guidebook.npc.quest.piko.2.title: The Lone Shopkeeper &e[2]
guidebook.npc.quest.piko.3.desc_1: The shopkeeper makes a call to her father, only to recieve a voice message that their home has been overrun and that he's heading to the &bAbyss&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.piko.3.desc_2: Upon telling her that the abyss portals have been shut and that there were presumably no survivors, she is devastated.
guidebook.npc.quest.piko.3.desc_3: She says all she knows about the &bcure&r is that there should have been a team of researchers that headed to the &btop floor&r of the mall.
guidebook.npc.quest.piko.3.title: The Lone Shopkeeper &c[END]
guidebook.npc.quest.tyberghein.0.desc_1: I ran into a neurosurgeon in a ruined hospital in the Highrise Residential District.
guidebook.npc.quest.tyberghein.0.title: The Curious Doctor &a[START]
guidebook.npc.quest.tyberghein.1.desc_1: He seems to know how to make the &bcure&r, but lacks the machines to do so.
guidebook.npc.quest.tyberghein.1.desc_2: He can tell me more if I help to clear out some of the horde.
guidebook.npc.quest.tyberghein.1.title: The Curious Doctor &e[1]
guidebook.npc.quest.tyberghein.2.desc_1: The doctor reveals that the &bcure&r he and the world knows how to make is &cincomplete&r and does not prevent the infection, only stop it.
guidebook.npc.quest.tyberghein.2.desc_2: This cure was shared across the internet &bby an unknown party&r. It seems there are some ingredients missing from the &dtrue cure&r, the secrets of which perhaps are only known to &bContinuumTech&r, the company that made it.
guidebook.npc.quest.tyberghein.2.desc_3: He requests some samples of rotten flesh to try and narrow down the ingredients needed.
guidebook.npc.quest.tyberghein.2.title: The Curious Doctor &e[2]
guidebook.npc.quest.tyberghein.3.desc_1: The doctor reveals that the missing ingredients come from the &bAbyss&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.tyberghein.3.desc_2: Unfortunately, with the &bportals&r shut by the &bmilitary&r, it is &cno longer accessible&r. The entire region has also since been turned into a radioactive &6Wasteland&r.
guidebook.npc.quest.tyberghein.3.desc_3: He recommends that I gather &bresearch papers&r from other groups — &bfive&r in total. They should have set up bases in &blandmark structures&r in all five districts.
guidebook.npc.quest.tyberghein.3.desc_4: There is also perhaps a chance the &bportal&r can be &breactivated&r. To do this, I must acquire a &bGas Mask&r somewhere in the &6Retail District&r, gain access to the portal in the &6Wasteland&r, then reactivate it.
guidebook.npc.quest.tyberghein.3.title: The Curious Doctor &c[END]
